context: Force-directed network graph showing 400 nodes across 7 organizational clusters with ~600 edges, rendered on canvas with SVG overlay for interaction
first_impression: Polished dark-theme network visualization with well-separated clusters, a deliberate colorblind-safe palette, and tastefully faint edge fabric that keeps focus on the node groupings.
what_works: The Tol bright palette is a conscious, non-default choice that works beautifully against the navy background — each cluster reads clearly. Edge opacity at 0.15 globalAlpha strikes the right balance: the network structure is legible without overwhelming the cluster signal.
what_doesnt: The gray 'Support' cluster blends somewhat into the dark background at smaller node sizes, weakening its distinctiveness relative to the other six clusters. Cluster spatial separation is moderate — at the boundaries, adjacent clusters (e.g. cyan and blue) bleed into each other, making it harder to read the grouping structure at a glance without hovering.
